unsupported_statements: "The model scores it at the 85th percentile for likely denial" – the facts give only a risk_score_percentile of 85; nothing says it is a model score or that it measures likelihood of denial.

"48 of 136 resource requests come from the 659 dept requests" – the facts give 48 as dept_resource_requests (requests for this resource from the department), 136 as resource requests and 659 as department requests; the phrasing misstates how the numbers relate.
